thesis: The hosts celebrate the 10th anniversary of the Acquired podcast by recording a special episode in the Google garage, the location of the company's first office. They discuss their decision to invite Michael Lewis, a fellow Princeton graduate and author, to co-host the anniversary celebration and reflect on the podcast's growth and impact since its inception.
